investigations.title: Legacy handover writes in wccs_runner.py
investigations.description: wccs_runner.py contained dead functions (_handover_excerpt, build_llm_prompt, parse_llm_response, build_new_handover, update_sfl_agent, write_session_log) that referenced and wrote VKB_SpinDoctor_Handover_vXX.md files. STATUS/HISTORY/ACCA are the source of truth — handover files must never be created.
steps_taken: Searched aafl_wccs.py and wccs_runner.py for VKB_SpinDoctor_Handover writes
Found 6 dead functions in wccs_runner.py referencing handover files
Removed all 6 dead functions: _handover_excerpt, build_llm_prompt, parse_llm_response, build_new_handover, update_sfl_agent, write_session_log
Verified main() does not call any handover-writing code
aafl_wccs.py: archive_old_handovers() already present and correct (moves, not creates)

investigations.title: WCCS speed — missing step timings
investigations.description: aafl_wccs.py had timing on STATUS rewrite, HISTORY append, ACCA append, and git commit steps but was missing timing on git push, clipboard copy, timeline build, and bridge post. No slow-step warning existed (>10s threshold).
steps_taken: Audited all steps in aafl_wccs.py main()
Enhanced _elapsed() to report per-step time AND cumulative time
Added *** SLOW >10s *** warning when any step exceeds threshold
Added timing to: git push, clipboard copy, timeline build, bridge post
Added 30-second timeout to git push subprocess call

investigations.title: Info panels hidden behind tabs — z-index full audit
investigations.description: This bug has failed twice before (OCB-E Phase 3, OCB-Q Phase 2). Root cause: .htl-popup-v2 used position:absolute inside an overflow:auto container (#htl-outer), which clips the popup. The main tab-bar had z-index:1000 which buried it above tooltips. Inner health-suite tab bar had z-index:10 which was too low.
steps_taken: Full grep of position:absolute, position:fixed, position:relative across mission_control.html
Found .htl-popup-v2{position:absolute;z-index:9999} inside #htl-outer{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:visible}
CSS rule: overflow-x:auto overrides overflow-y:visible to overflow-y:auto, clipping the popup
Fix: changed .htl-popup-v2 to position:fixed — JS already uses getBoundingClientRect() so coords are correct
Updated z-index scale comment: tab-bar=100, panels=100, popups=9999, tooltips=99999
Changed .tab-bar{z-index:1000} to z-index:100 to stop tab bar covering popups
Changed .hs-tab-bar{z-index:10} to z-index:100 for consistency
Updated CSS variables for theme consistency: --pb-bg, --pb-card, --pb-accent, --pb-border

investigations.title: OCB Runner parser stuck at analysing structure
investigations.description: parse_ocb_block() had no timeout, so pathological inputs could block the thread indefinitely. The forgiving fallback (pass 3) was missing — inputs without === Phase N === headers or bare Phase N: lines produced empty task lists.
steps_taken: Read ocb_runner.py parse_ocb_block() function
Found no timeout protection on the parse loop
Added concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor with 30-second timeout
Renamed inner function to _parse_ocb_block_inner()
Added Pass 3 forgiving fallback: matches lines starting with N. or === as phase boundaries
Added Pass 4 (was Pass 3) fallback: entire text as one Task Block
Wrote ocb_runner_tests.py with 8 tests including colour-change test
Results written to data/ocb_runner_test_results.json

investigations.title: Theme consistency — CSS variable mismatch
investigations.description: The Project Brain theme CSS variables (--pb-bg: #1a1a2e, --pb-card: #252540, --pb-accent: #c084fc) used purple/navy colours that were inconsistent with the hardcoded dark theme values (#0d0d0d, #111, #4af) used throughout the rest of the HTML.
steps_taken: Audited all CSS variables and hardcoded colour values in mission_control.html
Found mismatch: --pb-bg=#1a1a2e vs body background #0d0d0d at line 38 (line 1062 override wins)
Updated CSS variables to match existing dark theme: --pb-bg=#0d0d0d, --pb-card=#111820, --pb-accent=#4af, --pb-border=#1e2a3a, --pb-text=#ccd, --pb-text-muted=#778, --pb-active=#4f4
